lines.beaver: 지후 씨, 요즘 일하는 태도가 좋아 보여요.
lines.beaver_en: Jihu, your attitude at work looks good these days.
lines.beaver_roman: Jihu ssi, yojeum ilhaneun taedoga joa boyeoyo.
lines.learner: 감사해요. 재능보다 태도가 중요하지 않을까 해요.
lines.en: Thank you. I think attitude might matter more than talent.
lines.roman: Gamsahaeyo. Jaeneungboda taedoga jungyohaji aneulkka haeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Really? What about talent? Aptitude matters too.
lines.learner: 소질도 있어야죠. 하지만 끈기가 없으면 힘들어요.
lines.en: Aptitude is needed too. But without perseverance, it's hard.
lines.roman: Sojildo isseoyajyo. Hajiman kkeungiga eopseumyeon himdeureoyo.

lines.beaver: 맞아요. 재능이 있어도 금방 포기하면 안 되죠.
lines.beaver_en: Right. Even with talent, you can't give up quickly.
lines.beaver_roman: Majayo. Jaeneungi isseodo geumbang pogihamyeon an doejyo.
lines.learner: 네, 인내심도 곧 재능이 되지 않을까 해요.
lines.en: Yes, I think patience might become a talent too.
lines.roman: Ne, innaesimdo got jaeneungi doeji aneulkka haeyo.

lines.beaver: 리더십은 어때요? 지후 씨는 어떻게 생각해요?
lines.beaver_en: What about leadership? What do you think, Jihu?
lines.beaver_roman: Rideosibeun eottaeyo? Jihu ssineun eotteoke saenggakaeyo?
lines.learner: 리더십도 성의 있는 태도에서 나오지 않을까 해요.
lines.en: I think leadership might also come from a sincere attitude.
lines.roman: Rideosipdo seongui inneun taedoeseo naoji aneulkka haeyo.

lines.beaver_en: What about enthusiasm? Is it important at work?
lines.learner: 열의가 있으면 창의력도 생기는 것 같아요.
lines.en: With zeal, I think creativity comes too.
lines.roman: Yeoruiga isseumyeon changuiryeokdo saenggineun geot gatayo.

lines.beaver: 좋은 생각이에요. 일을 할 때는 어떤 태도가 좋아요?
lines.beaver_en: Good thought. What attitude is good when working?
lines.beaver_roman: Joeun saenggagieyo. Ireul hal ttaeneun eotteon taedoga joayo?
lines.en: You should prepare meticulously and work with devotion.

lines.beaver: 그런데 너무 조심하면 기회를 놓칠 수도 있어요.
lines.beaver_en: But if you're too careful, you might miss chances.
lines.beaver_roman: Geureonde neomu josimhamyeon gihoereul nochil ssudo isseoyo.
lines.en: Right. When needed, you should take on challenges boldly.

lines.beaver: 반대로 피해야 할 태도는 뭐라고 생각해요?
lines.beaver_en: On the other hand, what attitude should we avoid?
lines.beaver_roman: Bandaero pihaeya hal taedoneun mworago saenggakaeyo?
lines.learner: 불성실한 태도요. 신뢰를 잃게 되지 않을까 해요.
lines.en: An insincere attitude. I think you might lose trust.
lines.roman: Bulsseongsilhan taedoyo. Silloereul ilke doeji aneulkka haeyo.

lines.beaver: 지후 씨 말을 들으니 남다른 각오가 느껴져요.
lines.beaver_en: Listening to you, I can feel your special determination.
lines.beaver_roman: Jihu ssi mareul deureuni namdareun gagoga neukkyeojyeoyo.
lines.en: I'll keep today's talk in mind and try my best to the end.

lines.beaver: 좋아요. 그 마음 잊지 말고 차분히 해 봐요.
lines.beaver_en: Good. Don't forget that feeling and take it calmly.
lines.beaver_roman: Joayo. Geu maeum itji malgo chabunhi hae bwayo.
lines.learner: 네, 선배님. 좋은 태도를 꼭 지킬게요.
lines.en: Yes, senior. I'll be sure to keep a good attitude.
lines.roman: Ne, seonbaenim. Joeun taedoreul kkok jikilgeyo.
